content: Repair catalog.page(records, cursor=None, limit=2). Records have unique integer id and integer score. Order by descending score then ascending id. Cursor is a (score,id) pair identifying the last returned ordering position; return only records strictly after it, even if that cursor record is absent. Return (items, next_cursor); next_cursor is the last returned pair only if additional records remain, otherwise None. Reject nonpositive limits and preserve inputs.
